items.name: Acrobatics
items.example_uses: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.
items.specialties: balancing, escape artistry, swinging, tumbling

items.name: Animal Handling
items.example_uses: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.
items.specialties: calming, driving, farming, riding, training

items.name: Arcana
items.example_uses: Recall lore about spells, magic items, psionics, and the planes of existence.
items.specialties: aberrations, constructs, detection, dragons, elementals, fey, forbidden knowledge, monstrosities, oozes, the planes, psionics, psionic items, psionic creatures

items.name: Athletics
items.example_uses: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.
items.specialties: climbing, jumping, lifting, running, swimming, throwing, zero-g

items.name: Culture
items.example_uses: Know the customs, laws, trade in regional products, and etiquette of other cultures.
items.specialties: etiquette, laws, linguistics, regional goods, streetwise, courtly manners, trade

items.name: Deception
items.example_uses: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.
items.specialties: boasting, ciphers, concealing emotions, mimicry

items.name: Engineering
items.example_uses: Know a fact or advance a project involving building, invention, or mathematics.
items.specialties: architecture, chemistry, explosives, gadgetry, mathematics, mechanical traps, siegecraft, robotics, starship engines, starship shields

items.name: History
items.example_uses: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.
items.specialties: arts, empires, genealogy, legends, wars

items.name: Insight
items.example_uses: Discern a person’s mood and intentions.
items.specialties: detecting lies, reading emotions, sensing motives

items.name: Intimidation
items.example_uses: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.
items.specialties: authority, ferocity, interrogation, subtle threats, weapon displays

items.name: Investigation
items.example_uses: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.
items.specialties: appraisal, deciphering, forensics, gathering rumors, research, trapfinding, sensors

items.name: Medicine
items.example_uses: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.
items.specialties: animals, autopsy, diseases, herbalism, poisons, xenobiology

items.name: Nature
items.example_uses: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.
items.specialties: astronomy, beast lore, farming, fey, plant lore, weather

items.name: Perception
items.example_uses: Using a combination of senses, notice something that’s easy to miss.
items.specialties: farsight, invisible objects, listening, scent

items.name: Performance
items.example_uses: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.
items.specialties: acting, composing, dancing, fine art, singing, speaking, writing

items.name: Persuasion
items.example_uses: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.
items.specialties: bribery, flattery, leadership, negotiation, peacemaking

items.name: Religion
items.example_uses: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.
items.specialties: alignment, celestials, cults, fiends, holy symbols, gods, morality, prophecy, undead

items.name: Science
items.example_uses: Apply knowledge of the hard or advanced sciences not covered by Engineering, Nature, or Medicine.
items.specialties: astronomy, chemistry, physics, technobabble, mathematics

items.name: Sleight of Hand
items.example_uses: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.
items.specialties: distraction, pickpocketing, legerdemain

items.name: Stealth
items.example_uses: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.
items.specialties: anonymity, camouflage, casing

items.name: Survival
items.example_uses: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
items.specialties: dungeoneering, foraging, hunting, tracking, wayfinding, astrogation
